title: Messages on the lights
intro: Visitors send a message (their own words or one of yours), an animated picture or an effect of the season, or their own drawing, and each is shown on the matrix in turn. Messages go through a word filter. Pick the matrix, then Save.

fields.text: Pictures (73 animated GIFs of the season)

Visitors may write their own message (word filter on); off: only the messages below
